declared_question: What is the equilibrium mass-weighted radius of gyration of this molecule under its ab initio molecular-dynamics trajectory, and how much of the trajectory is needed to estimate it to a stated precision?
relation_to_sibling_protocol: This protocol shares its data source with rmd17-system-state-v1 and touches neither its split, its selected alphas, nor its locked benzene/uracil evaluation. It reads only the two development-role systems.

frame_ordering.meaning: restores the frame order of the original ab initio trajectory; rMD17's own array order is unrelated to simulation time

observable.name: mass-weighted radius of gyration
observable.formula: Rg(frame) = sqrt( sum_a m_a * |r_a - r_com|^2 / sum_a m_a )

excluded_by_design: replicate-trajectory dependence: rMD17 provides exactly one ab initio trajectory per molecule
force-field sensitivity: the reference level is a single DFT method, not a family of classical force fields
any new simulation: this reads an existing, already-completed trajectory only
